title: Eager materialization of large collections
summary: Creating large arrays with map/select before consuming results increases memory pressure and GC work.
rationale: Ruby enumerable chains are often expressive, but eager operations can materialize more data than needed.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use lazy enumerators, find_each in Rails, streaming APIs, or batch processing to avoid holding the full result set in memory.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
